title: Evidence manifest checker
statement: The repository validates every active manifest's complete nested schema, local paths and digests, object binding, trust class, pinned Axeyum revision, producer, checker result, and named negative-control failure, and exposes the same route through a typed single-manifest Python interface.
scope: Active schema-version-1 manifests under artifacts/claims. The aggregate gate and typed single-manifest interface reproduce declared producers and checkers and require negative controls to exit nonzero with their named failure classes.

evidence.checker_command: python3 -m unittest scripts.tests.test_check_artifacts scripts.tests.test_evidence_manifest && python3 scripts/check_artifacts.py --run
evidence.note: Four structural mutations and six typed-interface controls exercise schema fields, digest syntax, path confinement, expected positive text, nonzero control status, and named failure classes. The live route reproduces producers, checks post-production digests, matches positive output, and matches each negative failure class.
